title: ComputeJobStatus
description: GET /v1/jobs/{id} of a compute worker (protocol blocwerk-compute/1), the body of DELETE /v1/jobs/{id} and of every progress callback. Also status.json of a runner envelope result.

progress.description: Monotone within a run; 1.0 on success. Rounded to 3 decimals.

stage.description: Short text for a progress label ('queued', 'done', or a kind's stage).

stageDetail.description: Finer detail within the stage, e.g. 'step 1200/5000'.

message.description: Human-readable note, e.g. why it was cancelled.

error.description: Set iff status is failed; no server paths. Unexpected failures read 'internal error (ref <id>)'.

result.description: Set iff status is succeeded; shape per kind (docs/protocol.md).

jobResult.description: Per-kind fields, plus 'files' when the kind produces files.

files.description: Workers send {name, url}; the app also reads a bare name (runner envelope results).

url.description: Path of GET /v1/jobs/{id}/files/{name}, relative to the worker's base URL (it starts with /v1/).
